architecture_summary: Canary-only decomposition. Marketplace behavior is separated from a reference adapter so existing Location Scout and Reel Organizer contracts remain downstream-owned. Construction is intentionally blocked until AI Orchestrator and XDT1 resolve ownership and approval of the two required QN Market shared contracts.

architectural_proposals.proposal: Separate marketplace core behavior from cross-boat reference adaptation.
architectural_proposals.rationale: Avoids copying or modifying downstream-owned schemas.

architectural_proposals.proposal: Expose marketplace behavior through a narrow boundary over the marketplace core contract.
architectural_proposals.rationale: Lets future builders implement scoped work packages without reinterpreting the full mission.

components.name: QN Market Boundary
components.responsibility: Expose marketplace-facing commands and queries over the approved core contract.
components.boundary: Must not bind directly to Location Scout or Reel Organizer internals.

components.name: QN Market Core
components.responsibility: Implement listing/product/offer behavior after the marketplace core contract is approved.
components.boundary: May consume approved shared contracts but may not define or silently change them.

components.name: QN Market Reference Adapter
components.responsibility: Translate stable QN Market references to downstream-owned location and media references.
owned_scope: compatibility boundary to approved downstream contracts
components.boundary: References downstream contracts only; no authority to mutate their repositories or schemas.

interfaces.purpose: Reference approved Location Scout entity types.

data_control_flow.action: Map request to the approved marketplace core contract.
Resolve location/media references through the approved cross-boat contract.
Use downstream-owned references without schema mutation.

build_order: GATE-01 resolve owner and approve qn-market.marketplace-core-contract via XDT2 -> AI Orchestrator / QN Master -> XDT1 Material
GATE-02 resolve owner and approve qn-market.cross-boat-reference-contract via XDT2 -> AI Orchestrator / QN Master -> XDT1 Material

work_packages.mission_slice: Provide a stable compatibility boundary to existing location/media materials.
work_packages.architecture_boundary: Adapter only; do not mutate downstream schemas or invent the unresolved shared contract.

work_packages.mission_slice: Implement marketplace core behavior against approved shared contracts.
work_packages.architecture_boundary: Core behavior only; shared material definition remains outside the builder boundary.

work_packages.mission_slice: Expose a narrow marketplace-facing boundary over approved core behavior.
work_packages.architecture_boundary: Boundary maps only to the approved core contract and never directly to downstream internals.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every component stays within its architecture boundary and consumes only approved material/contract IDs.
The reference adapter does not copy, redefine, or mutate Location Scout or Reel Organizer contracts.
Marketplace core behavior is implemented only after both required QN Market shared contracts are approved.
The marketplace boundary depends on the core contract and not on downstream-owned internals.
No construction work begins while unresolved ownership/contract decisions remain blocking.

risks.risk: Assigning component ownership before Orchestrator resolves the two new shared contracts would invent authority.
risks.mitigation: Keep owner_assignment unresolved and construction blocked.

risks.risk: Directly importing downstream schemas into marketplace core would create cross-owner coupling.
risks.mitigation: Use the reference-adapter boundary and approved external contract IDs only.

escalation_requirements.reason: Marketplace core contract ownership is unknown.
escalation_requirements.path: XDT2 -> AI Orchestrator / QN Master -> XDT1 Material
escalation_requirements.required_resolution: Assign authoritative owner and obtain approved canonical contract before construction.

escalation_requirements.reason: Cross-boat reference contract ownership is unknown.
escalation_requirements.path: XDT2 -> AI Orchestrator / QN Master -> XDT1 Material
escalation_requirements.required_resolution: Assign authoritative owner and obtain approved canonical contract before construction.

authorization.reason: Canary only and the approved XDT1 Material Plan contains unresolved shared-contract ownership.

restrictions: CANARY ONLY: this Build Plan does not authorize building QN Market.
Do not redefine approved XDT1 materials or contracts.
Do not mutate QNCC, Location Scout, Reel Control, Reel Organizer, or other downstream product repositories.
Do not start XDT3 construction from this canary while authorization.construction_authorized is false.
